pages.title: Trap Step
pages.creator: Chiarly
pages.description:
Trap Step is a platform game designed around misleading scenery and unexpected hazards. Floors can disappear, bridges can be invisible, and a familiar-looking route can change through reversed gravity or a chasing wall. Each failed attempt helps reveal what the level is hiding.

Forty levels are arranged across eight doors, with bounce pads, rising lava, and deceptive spikes among the obstacles. Learn when a surface can be trusted and adjust your route as new traps appear. If a level keeps stopping your progress, a skip becomes available after five attempts.

pages.title: Lazy Dog
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Lazy Dog asks you to return a ball to a waiting dog using drawn lines and ropes. Plan the angles and timing so gravity carries the ball along the right route. Collect bones as you guide it to its owner for a stronger score.

pages.title: Pubg Hack
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pubg Hack drops you into a battlefield to search for supplies and fight other combatants. Choose a landing location, explore the map, and gather what you need for the encounters ahead. Use clicks or taps to take part in the shooting action.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Hawaii
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Hawaii combines color matching shots with tropical themed levels. Aim bubbles into matching groups while dealing with special pieces such as row clearing bubbles, rocks, and hidden bubbles. Follow the level map and adapt your shots to each arrangement.

pages.title: Spellmind
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Spellmind combines match three puzzles with restoring a magical school inside an old mansion. Complete colorful boards to continue Sabrina's story, explore the rooms, and select furniture and decorations. Rebuild the school while uncovering the mystery of its missing wizard.

pages.title: Tap Car
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Tap Car challenges you to clear arrangements of cars facing different directions. Click a car to move it along its indicated route, first checking whether other vehicles block the way. Free accessible cars to create room for those still trapped behind them.

pages.title: Bus Driver Simulator 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bus Driver Simulator 3D lets you drive buses through locations with different road and traffic conditions, from Los Angeles highways to Alaska's snowy terrain. Steer with WASD, use Space for the handbrake, and switch the camera with C while handling the route.

pages.title: Emoji Merge Fun Moji
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Emoji Merge Fun Moji lets you combine emojis to create new comic expressions and characters. Select the available emoji choices and merge them to discover the resulting designs. Experiment with different combinations as you work through the game's playful challenges.

pages.title: Snake 2048
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Snake 2048 starts you as a small cube snake in an arena with other players. Eat smaller snakes to grow and stay away from stronger rivals that can threaten you. Steer with the cursor or mobile joystick and compete for a higher leaderboard position.

pages.title: Real Driving Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Driving Simulator lets you unlock vehicles and drive them through cities and along tracks. Explore the available routes and try different cars as you progress. Use the game's click or tap controls to take part in its driving challenges.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car Stunts
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Mega Ramp Car Stunts challenges you to reach the finish across elevated tracks filled with obstacles. Tackle Stunt and Giant Ramp modes while keeping the car safely on course. Collect enough green diamonds to buy improved vehicles from the garage.

pages.title: Kitchen Star
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Kitchen Star scrambles pictures by rotating connected sections of their outlines. Use the rotation buttons to turn the pieces until their lines form the correct image again. Solve each picture with fewer turns to earn a better score.

pages.title: Toilet Paper Please
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Toilet Paper Please puts you in control of a toilet roll searching for scattered pieces before time expires. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and avoid bouncing waste and other hazards. Complete the collection challenges and face bosses along the way.

pages.title: Squad Goals: Soccer 3D
pages.creator: Prune Games
pages.description: Squad Goals: Soccer 3D turns soccer into a scramble where the first goal wins. Drag to run, then release to tackle, shoot, or pass as you chase the ball. There are no fouls, cards, or offside calls to interrupt the contest.

pages.title: Road Madness
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Road Madness combines road driving with car combat. Shoot enemy vehicles, dodge obstacles, and collect powerups from special opponents you destroy. Defeat the boss at the end of a level, then improve your equipment and unlock stronger cars for later battles.

pages.title: Minigolf Clash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Minigolf Clash asks you to complete courses in as few strokes as possible. Different golf balls have distinct properties, giving you alternative ways to handle a hole. Spend your rewards on more balls and increasingly difficult levels as you improve your shots.

pages.title: Hack This!
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Hack This! turns a fictional school bully's computer into an arcade infiltration challenge. Guide your attack through the virtual hard drive, bypass firewalls, and collect embarrassing files. Gather new viruses while working deeper into the game's computer environment.

pages.title: The Household
pages.creator: Crazy Panda Limited
pages.description: The Household lets you develop a home garden and farm while building a family life. Make friends with neighbors and work together as you improve the property. Shape the land and household into the kind of home you want to create.

pages.title: Archer Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Archer Defense asks you to stop waves of enemies with an upgradable bow and supporting defenses. Add sentries or barbed wire, and use arrow effects such as explosions, freezing, and multishot. Obtain cards from lootboxes to unlock additional bows and strengthen your position.

pages.title: Halloween Sliding Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Halloween Sliding Puzzle divides an image into movable tiles around a blank space. Click a tile beside the gap to slide it across and gradually restore the picture. Keep rearranging the pieces until their positions form the correct image.

pages.title: Worlds Hardest Challenge Fill Fridge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Worlds Hardest Challenge Fill Fridge asks you to fit a collection of foods into a refrigerator. Arrange the items to make effective use of its shelves and available space. Everything must be stored before you can move on to the next level.

pages.title: Jetpack Race Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Jetpack Race Run sends stick figures flying along a course toward a final platform. Hold and drag to change your position around the incoming walls. Keep clear of the obstacles so you can maintain speed and reach the finish ahead of the other racers.

pages.title: Fruit Link - Crazy Match Puzzle
pages.creator: ncsupergame
pages.description: Fruit Link - Crazy Match Puzzle asks you to remove matching fruit tiles in pairs. Each connection must use no more than three straight lines. Clear boards quickly and connect distant partners to earn stars that unlock additional cities.

pages.title: Solitaire Klondike
pages.creator: Armath
pages.description: Solitaire Klondike has you arrange tableau cards in descending order with alternating colors, then build each suit from Ace to King on the foundations. Move available cards to expose the ones beneath. Choose between drawing one card or three from the stock.

pages.title: Noob vs Pro Squid Challenge
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob vs Pro Squid Challenge lets two players tackle a sequence of survival contests. Advance during safe moments in the movement challenge, then compete in activities such as tug of war. Noob uses A and Pro uses P, with touch controls also available.

pages.title: Mr Bean - Solitaire Adventures
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Mr Bean - Solitaire Adventures follows Mr Bean on a card playing trip across the United States. Clear cards by matching a rank one higher or lower than the current card, regardless of suit. Continue the solitaire journey through cities including New York and San Francisco.

pages.title: Keeper of the Grove
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Keeper of the Grove asks you to protect magical crystals from invading creatures. Grow different nature defenders along the route and use their abilities to stop the thieves. Start each wave when ready and adjust the speed while watching your defenses hold the grove.

pages.title: Abacus 3D
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Abacus 3D turns an abacus into a color sorting puzzle. Drag its beads around to build vertical columns of the same color, then merge those groups. Keep reorganizing the beads until the abacus is cleared and the level is complete.

pages.title: Battle Royale Puzzles
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Battle Royale Puzzles offers twelve picture puzzles featuring Fortnite scenes. Drag one piece onto another position to exchange them and restore the complete image. Finish each board before its time limit expires to proceed to the next picture.

pages.title: Santa Puzzles
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Santa Puzzles offers twelve Santa themed pictures split into rearrangeable pieces. Drag a piece onto another position to swap them and rebuild the selected image. Complete each picture before the time limit expires to continue to the next puzzle.

pages.title: The Celebrity Way of life
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: The Celebrity Way of life lets you create a celebrity wardrobe for a variety of occasions. Choose clothing and combine the available pieces into a look for each event. Use the mouse to browse the fashion options and finish each outfit.

pages.title: Princesses quarantine Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princesses quarantine Trends lets you help Emma, Mia, and Clara develop new fashion looks while staying at home. Select outfits and accessories for the three princesses. Combine the available items to create a different style for each friend.

pages.title: Fail Run Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fail Run Online turns walking into a balancing challenge. Click or tap to adjust the character's steps and keep them moving without stumbling. Judge each stride carefully so the next foot placement helps the character stay upright.

pages.title: Test Drive Unlimited
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Test Drive Unlimited challenges you to time a car's movement across roads. Hold the mouse button to drive forward and collect coins, then release it to stop before crossing traffic. Choose safe moments to move through the vehicles ahead.

pages.title: Easter Pic Slider
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Easter Pic Slider asks you to rebuild Easter pictures by sliding their tiles into the adjacent empty space. Work out a sequence that returns each piece to its proper position. Finish quickly, because the available score decreases as time passes.

pages.title: [Hard] Spaceline Pilot
pages.creator: PunyGames.com
pages.description: [Hard] Spaceline Pilot is a space shooter set during humanity's escape from a collapsing planet. An artificial intelligence and its robot army threaten the transport routes. Use WASD or the arrow keys to maneuver your ship through the hostile space encounters.

pages.title: Semi Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Semi Trucks Jigsaw gives you twelve pictures of large trucks to reconstruct. Drag the scattered pieces into their correct positions with the mouse or a finger. Complete each image to work through the full set of truck puzzles.

pages.title: Kids Superheroes Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Kids Superheroes Memory hides superhero pictures behind tiles for you to pair up. Turn over two at a time, remember their positions, and clear identical images together. Try to complete the four levels with as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Planets
pages.creator: Brullworfel lab.
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Planets asks you to launch colored bubbles into matching groups of at least three. Aim with the mouse or touch controls and remove the clusters from the board. Clear the remaining bubbles to complete each level.

pages.title: Top Jumper 3D
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Top Jumper 3D challenges you to reach a finish line by timing your jumps. Tap to leap and work out how to get through each level's layout. Some stages require solving the route as well as choosing the right moment to jump.

pages.title: Drunken Duel
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Drunken Duel puts two unsteady gunfighters against one another in a physics driven shooting contest. Time your shots as their arms wobble and try to deplete the opponent's health. The left player uses W, while the right player uses the Up arrow or touch controls.

pages.title: Pond Race
pages.creator: Gametapas
pages.description: Pond Race challenges you to guide a frog to the finish faster than its rival. Click or tap the place you want to jump, selecting safe leaves while avoiding the pond's hazards. Work through the tracks and try to set a better completion time.

pages.title: Friend Rescue
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Friend Rescue presents rescue puzzles arranged around movable pins. Choose which barriers to pull and in what order so the character can reach safety. Work through the scene carefully, since removing a pin changes what can move through the level.

pages.title: Terrifying Clowns Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Terrifying Clowns Match 3 fills a matching board with clown themed pieces. Form rows of at least three matching colors to earn points and keep the left side gauge from dropping too low. Continue making combinations to extend the game and improve your score.

pages.title: Pizza Maker cooking games
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Pizza Maker cooking games lets you prepare a pizza, bake it in the oven, and slice the finished result. Work through the cooking activities to turn the ingredients into your chosen pizza. Complete the preparation before cutting it up to serve.

pages.title: Dr Bike Parking
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Dr Bike Parking offers motorcycle parking missions in a three dimensional environment. Ride the bike through each challenge and guide it into the required parking position. Use the available camera views to judge your approach and maneuver the motorcycle.

pages.title: Scientist Runner
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Scientist Runner follows a scientist through a laboratory where an accident has brought monsters and zombies to life. Move through its rooms and corridors while attacking the creatures in your way. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to strike.

pages.title: Colorful Clock
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Colorful Clock asks you to click when the moving clock hand matches the surrounding circle's color. Each correct match changes the hand's color and direction while the pace increases. A mistimed click or wrong color ends the attempt.

pages.title: Baby Hazel New Year Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel New Year Party lets you help Hazel and her mother host friends for New Year's Eve. Dress Hazel, prepare the dinner table, and respond to the guests' needs. Watch the hints to complete each request before someone waits too long.

pages.title: Water Car Stunt Racing 2019 3D Cars Stunt Games
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Water Car Stunt Racing 2019 3D Cars Stunt Games takes racing onto a floating water park course. Drive through its turns and use nitro when extra acceleration is needed. Begin with the amateur challenge before trying the more demanding races.

pages.title: Find the diwali gift
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Find the diwali gift is a point and click search for a concealed celebration present. Explore the scene, collect hidden objects, and follow clues to solve its puzzles. Use what you discover to locate the gift and prepare for the occasion.

pages.title: Female Fighter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Female Fighter follows Emily through a nightmare where strange creatures guard the doorways ahead. Move along the hallways, attack enemies, and use heavy strikes or evasive rolls to get through fights. Help her overcome the dream's opponents and find a way to wake.

pages.title: Funny Flowers Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Funny Flowers Jigsaw offers flower pictures to rebuild, with three difficulty modes for each image. Complete puzzles to earn game money, then spend it on additional pictures. Harder versions provide larger rewards for working through their pieces.

pages.title: Baby Sheep Coloring Game
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Baby Sheep Coloring Game gives you pictures of young sheep to color. Choose a page and apply the colors you prefer with the mouse or touch controls. Experiment with different shades to create your own version of each sheep illustration.

pages.title: Impossible Cargo Track
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Impossible Cargo Track puts you in a large cargo truck on difficult roads with tight turns. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer while keeping the load balanced. An unstable truck can damage the goods, so judge each maneuver carefully.

pages.title: Endless Car Chase
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Endless Car Chase has you drive away from police vehicles for as long as possible. Steer with WASD to keep the pursuit going and avoid being caught. Each attempt is a chance to survive longer through the continuing chase.

pages.title: Food And Delivery Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Food And Delivery Trucks Jigsaw offers twelve pictures of working trucks to rebuild. Choose an easy, medium, or hard version with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Fit the pieces into place using the mouse or touch controls to complete each vehicle image.

pages.title: Christmas Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Christmas Memory Challenge briefly reveals twelve holiday cards before hiding them. Remember the six picture pairs and turn over matching cards to clear the level. Each succeeding round reduces the time available, making accurate recall increasingly important.

pages.title: Super Flight Hero
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Super Flight Hero has you control a magical parachute to move through monsters and obstacles. Tap to open or release it, and land on monsters to gain extra height. Collect powers such as invincibility, stronger leaps, and firepower while increasing your score.

pages.title: Extreme Monster Trucks Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Extreme Monster Trucks Memory hides truck pictures behind tiles. Reveal two at a time and remember their locations to uncover matching pairs. Clear all the tiles across four levels while trying to keep your move count low.

pages.title: Christmas Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Christmas Memory Challenge asks you to find matching Christmas pictures hidden on a board. Turn cards over, note the images they reveal, and select their partners. Keep locating pairs until all the holiday images have been matched.

pages.title: Hyper Memory Cute Animals
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Memory Cute Animals has you uncover animal cards in identical pairs. If two revealed pictures differ, they turn back over, leaving you to remember their locations. Complete each level quickly and with few turns to earn a three star rating.

pages.title: Demolition Derby Challenge
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Demolition Derby Challenge puts you in a car combat arena where rivals can be knocked off the track or into a whirlpool. Ram other vehicles while protecting your own car from damage. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space to handbrake.

pages.title: Triler Truck Simulator Off Road
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Triler Truck Simulator Off Road challenges you to handle a loaded eighteen wheeler away from paved roads. Drive with WASD and account for the heavy trailer as you travel through rough terrain. Guide the cargo truck along the offroad routes.

pages.title: Puppy Pairs Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Puppy Pairs Puzzle offers six pictures of puppy pairs to assemble as jigsaws. Choose a 16, 36, 64, or 100 piece layout, then place the fragments where they belong. Rebuild each pet photograph at the difficulty you prefer.

pages.title: Ghost Rider
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Ghost Rider sends you across motorcycle courses where controlling speed and rotation is essential. Accelerate with W or Up, slow down with S or Down, and balance the bike with A and D. Work through the riding challenges using careful throttle control.

pages.title: Formula Racing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Formula Racing puts you behind the wheel of a racing car to compete around circuit tracks. Steer with the arrow keys and work through the bends while trying to get ahead of the other cars. Keep your line as you race toward the finish.

pages.title: Arcade Basketball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Arcade Basketball challenges you to throw balls into baskets before the round's time runs out. Drag to prepare a shot, release toward the hoop, and keep scoring as basket positions change. Reach the required scoring goals to continue the challenge.

pages.title: Rainbow Tile
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Rainbow Tile asks you to guide a small pixel between colored platforms. Choose the next step quickly while checking that a landing is available. Falling into a gap ends the run, so increasing your score depends on both speed and accurate choices.

pages.title: Catch Color
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Catch Color has you launch a colored ball toward a rotating multicolored ring. Tap when the matching section lines up with the ball's route. Keep making correct color contacts to increase your score while avoiding the other colored sections.

pages.title: Happy Glass
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Happy Glass asks you to draw a line that carries water into an empty glass. Study the level's arrangement and use your drawing to guide the flow toward it. Fill the glass to solve the puzzle and make it happy.

pages.title: Christmas Gift Sweeper
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Christmas Gift Sweeper has you exchange neighboring gift tiles to form rows of at least three identical presents. Remove the matching groups and work through the holiday boards. Complete the levels to unlock more of the gift matching puzzles.

pages.title: Princess on Camping
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Princess on Camping joins Jasmine and Rapunzel beside a mountain lake. Help with their outdoor barbecue and choose clothes for the trip. Work through the food and dress up activities as the princesses enjoy their campsite.

pages.title: Money Movers Maker
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Money Movers Maker lets you create escape levels and try stages designed by other players. Coordinate two criminals, evade security, collect money, and reach the exit. Use the level editor to build your own challenges and share them with the community.

pages.title: Summer Braided Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Summer Braided Hairstyles introduces Jenny as your model for three braided hair tutorials. Follow the hairstyling activities to create each look, working through the braiding steps. Use the mouse or a finger to prepare the summer hairstyles.

pages.title: Grogg.io
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Grogg.io drops you into a multiplayer pirate battle with treasure to uncover. Follow map markers, dig for loot, and fire cannonballs at rival pirates. Drink grogg to level up, then manage the items in your inventory as you continue the hunt.

pages.title: Bomb it 5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bomb it 5 asks you to navigate arenas, plant bombs, and eliminate opponents caught in their blasts. Move with the keyboard and place a bomb with Space. Different modes change the goal, including a race where reaching the finish first wins.

pages.title: DeathCar.io
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: DeathCar.io turns a driving arena into a fight for survival. Ram other vehicles from the sides or behind to damage them while keeping your own car alive. Save your boost for moments when a burst of speed can help an attack or escape.

pages.title: Turkcell Emocan
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Turkcell Emocan uses sliding rows of characters for a match three puzzle. Drag rows vertically or horizontally to bring identical characters together and clear them. Look across the board to plan which row movement will make the next match.

pages.title: Racing Nitro
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Racing Nitro challenges you to overtake rivals and finish races ahead of the pack. Collect nitro for bursts of speed and use it to help pass other cars. Spend race winnings on upgrades to improve your chances in later events.

pages.title: Operate Now: Shoulder Surgery
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Operate Now: Shoulder Surgery casts you as the surgeon treating Noah after a tennis injury. Follow the operation's instructions and select the appropriate medical tools for its stages. Complete the shoulder procedure to help the patient recover.

pages.title: Hatchimals Maker
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Hatchimals Maker has you care for an egg before meeting the creature inside. Touch and clean the egg, entertain its occupant with songs, and answer questions that shape its behavior. Keep helping until it hatches and reveals your new companion.

pages.title: Gorgeous Twins Spring Camp!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Gorgeous Twins Spring Camp! lets you help Rachel's twin daughters take part in a campsite dress up contest. Browse their clothing and choose an outfit for each girl. Compare different combinations to prepare the twins for their spring camping activity.

pages.title: Perfect Proposal Elsa
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Perfect Proposal Elsa asks you to help Jack Frost prepare a proposal for Elsa. Choose his outfit and hairstyle, arrange a romantic picnic, and help him write his proposal in the sky. Continue with wedding planning choices after the special moment.

pages.title: Strawberry Delicious Boutique!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Strawberry Delicious Boutique! lets you create treats in Strawberry's newly opened sweet shop. Choose ice cream flavors, add decorations to a cake, and finish a cupcake with the available toppings. Combine the choices to design desserts for the boutique.

pages.title: Princess Vintage Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Vintage Shop takes you clothing shopping with a princess interested in vintage fashion. Try the available items and choose which pieces to buy for her look. Combine the selections into an outfit drawn from the shop's collection.

pages.title: Ice Queen Winter Fashion!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Ice Queen Winter Fashion! asks you to prepare the Ice Queen for a castle ballroom event. Browse dresses and choose makeup to suit her evening look. Coordinate the available fashion options so she is ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Goldie Princess Laundry Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Princess Laundry Day follows Goldie through a load of washing. Sort white and colored clothes, add detergent, and start the machine. Hang the laundry outside to dry, then iron the clean garments to complete the household tasks.
